findings.text: The stale-manifest fixture sets manifest_baseline_mtime_ns one second after the manifest's mtime, while the real resume path records the baseline at the manifest's current mtime (reckon/crew/resumption.py:1428 via _manifest_mtime_ns) and only rewrites the file when its status is in the supervisor's done set, so a peer that delivered 'blocked' and was then resumed leaves mtime == baseline exactly; reckon/crew/runs.py:159 compares with a strict '>', which refuses that real case, but the fixture never exercises it, so a change of '>' to '>=' would keep this test green while admitting the predecessor's blocked verdict as the current attempt's delivery. Add a case whose baseline equals the manifest mtime.
